Nihal Sarin playing for the Novy Bor team took on Jorden van Foreest who is playing for the SuperChess Romania team. An intense match-up as both team had won all their matches. This would determine which team would become the European Club Cup 2026 champions! Check out the battle with commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
